model_annotation: The line graph illustrates the value of exports from Bulgaria to the United Kingdom across four different economic sectors, with the y-axis representing the export value in Bulgarian leva (BGN) and the x-axis representing the years from 2010 to 2022. The data shows that the "Създаване и разпространение на информация и творчески продукти; далекосъобщения" (Creation and distribution of information and creative products; telecommunications) sector experienced the most significant growth, with export values rising from approximately 30,000 BGN in 2010 to over 180,000 BGN in 2022. The "Преработваща промишленост" (Manufacturing) sector also saw a substantial increase, starting at around 30,000 BGN in 2010 and reaching nearly 190,000 BGN by 2022. In contrast, the "Селско, горско и рибно стопанство" (Agriculture, forestry, and fishing) sector remained relatively stable, with values fluctuating between 0 and 10,000 BGN throughout the period. The "Търговия; ремонт на автомобили и мотоциклети" (Wholesale and retail trade; repair of motor vehicles and motorcycles) sector showed a modest increase, starting at around 10,000 BGN in 2010 and reaching approximately 15,000 BGN in 2022. Overall, the graph highlights a strong upward trend in exports for the information and manufacturing sectors, while the other two sectors remained relatively flat.
